reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Justin Perez
reviews.text: Arjeldi fixed my driver wheel bearing and wheel hub. Excelent job and great customer service , if you guys need anything don’t hesitate on contacting him he will get it done for you the right way. Recommend Brake Boss 100% !!!

reviews.author: Tonni Von Schaumburg
reviews.text: My car was making a loud noise when I turned the wheel. Brake Boss was recommended by a friend. He came to my house at the agreed upon time, assessed the situation and completed the repair. It was great not having to go to a mechanic leave my car or wait hours for repairs. I would recommend Brake Boss to anyone in need of car repairs. I will definitely use him again if the need arises.

reviews.author: David Baldwin
reviews.text: Brake boss showed up when they were supposed to and did the job quickly and efficiently. They ran I to a bit of an issue with lock nuts but it wasn't trouble for him and he took care of it straight away. Price was right and the man who did the job was extremely nice and informative.

reviews.author: Mike Marenick
reviews.text: I’ve always handled the work on my Lotus myself or gone to the dealership since very few shops are familiar with these cars. This time, I decided to trust Arjeldi with a front and rear brake job and an oil change, and I couldn’t be happier. If I could give 10 stars, I would! He was professional and meticulous. The quality of his work was outstanding, and his pricing was more than fair. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: JD Perez
reviews.text: Definitely recommend! I was replacing my own brakes, rotors, and calipers but had an issue with a badly stripped bolt on the brake hose. My new caliper was leaking, and after working on it for 4 days, I needed to flare the brake line but didn't have the tools. At the last minute, I googled mobile mechanics and called Brake Boss at 5 pm on Friday. To my surprise, he said he could be at my house in 40 minutes. He fixed my leaking problem and was able to flare my brake hose. He charged me $125 to reflare and $35 to flush the single caliper. Five days later, I still have no leaks. I will update this if anything changes, but I definitely recommend them! The photos show the old and new bolt.

reviews.author: Marcos Hernandez
reviews.text: Words can’t explain how helpful he was. I never leave reviews, but he truly deserves it. He did my brakes last week, I thought I needed pads and rotors, but instead of upselling me, he told me I only needed pads. Saved me a couple hundred dollars. An honest mechanic who knows his stuff. Super knowledgeable, efficient, and had the job done in about 45 minutes. If I could give more stars, I would.

reviews.author: Jawad Ali
reviews.text: Knowledgeable and efficient mobile mechanic. Came out on time and swapped out an alternator for me when I was stranded in a parking lot. Would definitely recommend, very professional !!

reviews.author: Ahmed Alesayi
reviews.text: I really appreciate him . I had a trip and while driving back to New York . Then I had a flat tire. I went to couple different shops and all said we’re closed except him . He fixed it so quick with professionally. Best shop with the best brother man . Thank you again

reviews.author: Eileen Herkenham
reviews.text: Break Boss was incredibly prompt and very detailed in explaining what was wrong with my vehicle! He followed up and fixed in a very timely manner! He will now be our go to for any car issues that may arise!

reviews.author: jazwiz
reviews.text: Excellent service! When I called, he took the time to talk about my car and find out what was going on. I got an appointment right away, and the best part is that they come to you! Arjeldi is very knowledgeable, and I had complete confidence in him. He truly cares about the situation and his customers. He sent a follow-up text to make sure all was well. My car had a few different issues, one was more complex than the others and he was able to sort through it and get me back on the road. His prices are more than fair and his service is professional. He definitely goes above and beyond! If you are in need of repair or looking for basic service on your vehicle, just make the call, you won’t be sorry! A+++

reviews.author: Giorvani
reviews.text: Arjeldi is a great mechanic who cares about your car and does everything right to prevent future problems while working on your car. He follows all best practices as a mechanic to make sure your car is in tip top condition for the long haul. Highly recommend hiring Arjeldi. He is a great, mobile mechanic. Ten stars!

reviews.author: Michele Puluse
reviews.text: Highly recommend using this company! Arjeldi was professional, knowledgeable and trustworthy! The mobile service is also very convenient and does not disrupt a work day or weekend. Will definitely use in the future! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Petrit Mehmedoski
reviews.text: "Amazing service! BRAKE BOSS …. ARJELDI was incredibly knowledgeable, diagnosed the issue quickly, and explained everything clearly. "Fantastic experience! Arjeldi was friendly, efficient, and completed the repairs on time and within budget." "Finally found a mechanic I can trust! BRAKE BOSS is a true expert and always provides excellent quality work." THANK YOU AGAIN

reviews.author: Amani Shahin
reviews.text: Brake Boss Mobile Auto Repair came to my house yesterday morning to change my brakes before we drive to Canada! His honesty, his prices, the convenience, are a couple of the reasons why I will always use him for my car repairs. I didn’t even have to leave my home. He worked on my car in my driveway!! I was so impressed. Thank you again !!!!

reviews.author: Almira Mehmedoski
reviews.text: Best mechanic in NJ !!! Very fast to reply to my emails. He was very fast to give me a quote and fix my car! Arjeldi is very knowledgeable and the prices are excellent ! I don’t normally write review but had to because of his excellent service, definitely will go to Brake Boss from now on!

reviews.author: Iggy12
reviews.text: This company is a GODSEND, as somone with a busy schedule its a nightmare trying to get my car into a shop (not to mention all local shops are scheduling weeks out for service), but Arjeldi was a DELIGHT to deal with. Hyperprofessional, super nice and price was more than reasonable. I called on a Wednesday evening needing my brakes and rotors, I was scheduled for the next day. Having the business on wheels is a gigantic convenience for anyone with a busy schedule. Would recommend this company to everyone I know.

reviews.author: Jerico Delas Armas
reviews.text: Arjeldi was great to work with from start to finish. He’s knowledgeable and clearly loves his job. I was able to order my own brakes and rotors and have him install it. He has the option to buy the parts and install them as well. The best part? I didn’t have to leave my house! Thanks again Arjeldi!!

reviews.author: Joseph Salamone
reviews.text: My car's traction control & ABS lights came on. Brake boss was able to trouble shoot and fix the problem quickly & efficiently. Very professional and diligent. Very convenient, able to come right to my car! Beats driving to the auto shop when you have a busy schedule. Would highly recommend for everything your car needs.

reviews.author: Joy
reviews.text: Exceptional service and very professional. They came out the next day to fix an unexpected brake line issue. The issue was diagnosed quickly and the repairs were completed within a few hours. Will definitely be reaching out again if another issue arises and would 100% recommend.

reviews.author: Andrew Neary
reviews.text: Arjeldi was fantastic to work with! He was prompt, polite and super knowledgeable. He fixed the issue with my car super quick and efficiently. Didn’t charge nearly as much as the dealer or auto body shop. Would highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: M Pro
reviews.text: Good guy with quality work and fair pricing. Have gotten a ton of maintenance (brakes, transmission, differential, etc) done on my 2 cars over the last year with him and have had no issues at all.

reviews.author: Diana K.
reviews.text: I could not thank Brake Boss enough. I was visiting a friend in NJ from NH when suddenly my brakes gave out. He was kind enough to come to my friends house and check out my car. He was throughout with his diagnosis and had very fair pricing. Thanks to him I was able to get my car back for the 6 hour drive home safely which saved me a ton of money on a potential tow. Thank you so much again.

reviews.author: Ina Stoja
reviews.text: Brake Boss repaired the brakes on my 2010 Toyota Rav4. They were very professional and patient to answer all my questions. The prices are the best in the market! Will definitely use them again! I highly recommend Brake Boss.

reviews.author: Decks NJ
reviews.text: Arjeldi is the Boss! Showed up at my garage, diagnosed problem right down the the problem part, which I pocked up and replaced, and voila, vehicle started! Will definitely use his services again!

reviews.author: Zuleika Colon
reviews.text: I appreciate this guy sooo much ! He is very kind ..I was heading to the poconos to the great wolf lodge to celebrate my daughters birthday and we caught a flat . Everything was close & the spare tire was with no air ! We was stranded! I googled close places by and luckily found him he helped with no hesitation! I highly recommended this guy!!!! God bless him always!

They were very nice and professional. Later he texted me to check if I got home safely. I am very happy to have me and would recommend them anytime!
